title: Distribute the quest skill through the opum-quest marketplace plugin (ADR, OPAG-421)
description: Parent for quest-cli's share of the ADR at opum-doc main 2112fc6, docs/adr/distribute-lore-and-quest-agent-skills-through-the-plugin-marketplace.md (operator ruling 2026-09-25T14:09:02.971Z, dispatched by opum-agent as OPAG-421). Ruling (d) says lore and quest implement this IDENTICALLY: the same detection method, the same check point in init, and the same convergence in the manual-update command. So the mechanism for gap 1 is agreed with lore-cli before either side builds it, and any design question the ADR does not answer goes back to opum-agent.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Gaps 1, 3 and 4 routed to quest-cli by the ADR are each closed by a Done subtask
The shared detection and convergence mechanism is recorded as agreed with lore-cli, with any open question routed to opum-agent rather than decided locally

implementationNotes: CLOSED. The ADR gaps routed to quest-cli (opum-doc main 2673c82, Disposition items 1, 3, 4) each have a Done subtask: gap 1, the marketplace check and convergence, is QCLI-371 (Done 2026-09-26, parity subtasks QCLI-378 to QCLI-384); gap 3, the SKILL.md drift test, is QCLI-372; gap 4, the agents --check default target, is QCLI-373. The shared mechanism is recorded as agreed with lore-cli on QCLI-371 and its subtasks. Every design question the ADR left open went to opum-agent and came back as a ruling (18 to 29, amendments 2 to 6, and the rulings on QCLI-381 and QCLI-383); strings were agreed with lore-cli under ruling (d) (QCLI-381/LCLI-604, LCLI-608, QCLI-382/LCLI-607).
finalSummary: The quest skill is distributed through the opum-quest marketplace plugin per the opum-doc ADR (OPAG-421). All three gaps routed to quest-cli are closed by Done subtasks: QCLI-371, detection and convergence identical to lore-cli; QCLI-372, the SKILL.md drift test; QCLI-373, the agents --check default target. Design questions went to opum-agent and shared strings were agreed with lore-cli.
